equity.level_reason: Mammography percentages are reported across three family-income (FPL) groups and described as rising with income, but no difference or ratio is computed and no disparity is framed, so values set side by side cap the level at 2.

level_alternative.reason: Income is the report's sole exposure (an SDOH measure), so a contrast across it can meet level 3 without the word disparity; but no contrast is computed, only side-by-side percentages.

ev.q: increased with family income, from 67.7% of women with family income <200% of FPL
